name: bukharo
description: Bukharo — real-time 4-player team Rummy/Canasta web app

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bukharo/game-engine && npm run build -w @bukharo/shared && npm run build -w @bukharo/server && npm run build -w @bukharo/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @bukharo/game-engine && npm run test -w @bukharo/server && npm run test -w @bukharo/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @bukharo/server & npm run dev -w @bukharo/web
